goal.text: Keep your head safe when the ground shakes.

intro.text: You are in the corridor. The ground is shaking!

hint.text: There is no desk here. What can cover your head?

lesson.text: No desk? Still Duck, Cover, and Hold. Cover your head until the shaking stops.

choices.label: Duck and cover your head
choices.feedback: Duck down low. Cover your head with your arms or a book.

choices.label: Run to the stairs
choices.feedback: Do not run while it shakes. Stay where you are and cover your head.
